# Quotation response -- KR-RFQ-2026-11

Visakoivu Oy -- technical maintenance services, Ryhtila production and office facility

## Eligibility

2.1 Turnover for FY2025 was EUR 20,300,000, above the EUR 3,000,000 threshold.

2.2 Electrical professionals employed in-house exceed the minimum of 15.

2.3 Visakoivu has more than three comparable reference projects within the last five years.

2.4 Valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate held.

## Technical response

3.1 Environmental impacts during works, including waste, emissions and noise, are managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system.

3.2 Scheduled HVAC maintenance follows a fixed annual calendar for the contract period, across the production hall, machine shop and office wing.

3.3 Building envelope condition, including roofing and cladding, is assessed periodically as part of the maintenance scope.

3.4 Internal quality control and testing procedures apply to all completed maintenance and repair work.

3.5 A warranty period is offered on equipment and materials installed under the agreement.

3.6 Personnel observe the Buyer's site-access and security procedures throughout the facility.

3.7 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is programmed for the facility on the applicable cycle.

3.8 Scheduled maintenance visits follow a defined content and frequency, agreed with the Buyer's facilities contact at contract start.

3.10 Commissioning and testing follow a written protocol after equipment replacement.

3.11 A method statement is provided for installation work, scheduled to avoid disrupting production.

3.12 Unresolved faults escalate to a named supervisor, then to management, within the agreed timeframe.

3.13 Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on a defined schedule.

3.14 Continuity is maintained through cross-trained cover if key personnel change.

3.15 Condition-monitoring data is collected and reported to the Buyer's facilities contact.

3.16 Common spare parts are held in stock, with lead times confirmed on request.

## Commercial terms

4.1 A retention percentage, where applicable, is stated in the pricing schedule.

4.2 The payment terms set out in this request and its annexes are accepted.

4.3 Invoicing is monthly and available electronically.

4.4 Subcontractor costs, where used, are made transparent to the Buyer on request.

4.5 Pricing distinguishes fixed-price visits, unit-priced parts, and time-based call-out charging.

4.6 A discount structure is proposed, scaling with order volume over the contract period.

4.7 A cost breakdown supporting the headline price is enclosed.

## Forms enclosed

Subcontractor list (Liite 3).

## Format

6.1 The quotation does not exceed 20 pages, excluding attachments.

6.3 All prices are quoted excluding VAT, in euro.

6.5 The quotation is submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.

6.6 The closing time of 13 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time, is noted as the time the quotation is recorded as received.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

A.2 Maintenance activity and outstanding items are reported to the Buyer's facilities contact on a regular basis.

A.3 Site personnel hold the trade qualifications and site-induction requirements for the production areas.

A.4 Any subcontracted trades are selected and supervised under our standard management process.

A.5 A preventive maintenance plan covers all system categories described in this annex.

A.6 An on-call arrangement is maintained outside normal working hours, with response times by severity category.

## Liite B -- Kaupalliset ehdot

B.2 No advance payment is requested under this proposal.

B.3 Minimum font size used throughout, including commercial schedules, is 11pt.

## Liite C -- Lomakkeet

C.1 Description of our environmental management system is enclosed.

Visakoivu Oy
